summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Sariwarasa finance ledger. 22/22 pytest cases passed (auth, RBAC owner/team, transactions CRUD, Lainnya notes validation, transfers, events required fields, hutang/piutang full lifecycle w/ auto-created ledger tx, reports summary/pnl/cashflow, audit logs, file upload). AI extract endpoint verified manually with realistic PNG receipt: gpt-5.6-terra returned high-confidence expense draft (amount=85000, category=Buah, date=2026-01-15) in ~5-10s and persisted as draft. UI flows verified end-to-end: owner login, balance ticker visible on every page (Dashboard/Transactions), add income (Catering, Cash) closes drawer, Lainnya without notes shows error + drawer stays open, Reports page renders pnl-card/cashflow/balance/debts/audit-log cards, draft-alert-banner appears on dashboard when draft exists, Draft AI filter shows draft rows, add-debt + partial payment via UI works, logout returns to /login. Team user correctly hidden from add-transaction-btn, add-debt-btn, audit-log-card; POST endpoints return 403 as tested via API.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on transaction drawer and debt/payment dialogs — accessibility warning from Radix. Non-blocking but should add SheetDescription/DialogDescription.
Console warning: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' for tx-category-select and tx-fund-source-select — initial value should be undefined consistently.

'Saldo per Sumber Dana' card sometimes only renders the Total row on first paint while ticker shows populated balances (race between two /balances calls). Consider sharing balances via context to avoid duplicate fetches.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/SheetDescription to satisfy Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Normalize Select initial values (use undefined not empty string) to avoid controlled/uncontrolled warnings.
(Optional) Share balances state via context or React Query so Reports and BalanceTicker don't double-fetch and race.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 753-line module; consider splitting into routers (auth, transactions, debts, reports, ai, files) for maintainability.
Debt payment auto-creates a ledger transaction (good) — but there's no rollback if db.debts.update_one fails after transaction insert. Use a transactional pattern or compensating delete.
AI extraction persists a draft transaction even if user never reviews; there is no TTL/cleanup for abandoned drafts. Consider adding a housekeeping endpoint or drop-old-drafts cron.
Duplicate detection is basic (type+amount+date+fund_source). Same-day multi-transaction workflows will trigger false positives silently; consider surfacing which existing tx matched.
Balances loop is O(N) over all final transactions on every /balances call — will slow down as data grows. Pre-aggregate or use a materialized view.
Team role can list all users via GET /api/users? No — /users is owner-only. Good.
File serving endpoint proxies through Emergent objstore synchronously via `requests`; blocks the event loop. Should use httpx.AsyncClient or `run_in_executor`.
`init_storage` uses a module-global `storage_key`; race conditions possible under concurrent startup. Wrap with asyncio.Lock.
